items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: He was a drum player like Leo Addy

ctx.x: Did he uh... Read those arrangements? No, no, no Head arrangements

Just head, all in his head And he had a drum player All he had on that drum was one cymbal and one car bell He beat a powerful lot of rhythm out that drum He was a drum player like Leo Addy Played the same style as Leo Addy Played the same style as Leo That was a boy playing nice drums Did you ever hear him play?
Never did He was through by the time Used to play with Piesdorff
